title: Prove a sharp BIT closure bound for 457 optional owners
body:
The complete 36-call gain has maximum zero at κ = 0.003879928046156 and 0.003879929046155 in each separate fixed-original-pulse pure-zero class. The flow certificate covers every subset of the 457 optional helper owners. Three neutral literal projections replay, including the 650-owner union. Two first-edit owner-331 alias orders disturb the opposite orientation and each loses approximately 35.420917 at the first trial.

## Task and overlap

This refines the P104 campaign scope. #7912 `83ece5a62d3addbee45bad9594ef4809851b833b` supplies the neutral specialization. #7935 `86203c17e5bbecd4085067db1479e5858c896524` treats a different bounded second-owner/alias model. #7953 `13a47f662901e894fee93365c7efec89f4f21fae` fixes exterior stock for sink matching. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

Extract the archived `public/` directory, verify `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, and run `python3 -I -B verify.py` in Python 3.12. The relocated replay rebuilt both raw pulse rosters and exact rational chart legs, validated the optimistic integer flows and both directed valuations, replayed all five words and rejected a damaged flow, ADD and CLEAR.

## Open next questions

Repair the surviving `{332,333}` payload after the first owner-331 alias, with fresh opposite-direction data and all reader and productive debits. Physical ownership, erasure, precision, compiler and outer application remain under their stated premises.
